protocol:
Treg Polarization of Mouse CD4+ Cells
Harvest lymph nodes (superficial cervical, mandibular, axillary, inguinal, and mesenteric) from mice.
Tease lymph nodes through a sterile 70-µm nylon cell strainer to obtain single-cell suspensions incomplete RPMI containing 10% FCS (complete medium).
Resuspend cells in complete medium and use your favorite method to isolate CD4+cells.
Checkout Biocompare.com to find useful kits.
Plate CD4+cells at 1.0 x 106/1ml/well.
Culture cells for 5 days at 37°C, 5% CO2, in the presence ofanti-mouse CD28, clone 37.51 (3 µg/mL), recombinant mouse IL-2 (5 ng/mL), and recombinanthuman TGF-β1 (5 ng/ml).
On day 3, if media is yellow, add 2 ml/well of fresh media.
On day 5, after harvesting, the cells are ready for staining.
On day 0, coat 12-well plate with anti-mouse CD3ε, clone 145-2C11 (3 µg/ml).
Incubate at 37°C for 2 hours.
(Alternatively, incubate at 4°C overnight.)
Aseptically decant antibody solution from the plate.
Wash plate with sterile PBS (wash 1/3).
Wash plate with sterile PBS (wash 2/3).
Wash plate with sterile PBS (wash 3/3).
Discard liquid.

# Lab Automation Script
# Generated from protocol analysis


### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: tease (container: 70-µm nylon cell strainer, reagent: lymph nodes, other: {'medium': 'incomplete RPMI containing 10% FCS'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
resuspend(reagent='cells', medium='complete medium')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: isolate (reagent: CD4+ cells)

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
plate(container='well plate', reagent='CD4+ cells', volume='1 ml/well', cell_count='1.0 x 10^6/well')
culture(container='well plate', reagent='CD4+ cells', temperature='37°C', duration='5 days', CO2='5%', additives=[{'name': 'anti-mouse CD28, clone 37.51', 'concentration': '3 µg/mL'}, {'name': 'recombinant mouse IL-2', 'concentration': '5 ng/mL'}, {'name': 'recombinant human TGF-β1', 'concentration': '5 ng/mL'}])
add(container='well', reagent='fresh media', volume='2 ml/well', condition='if media is yellow (on day 3)')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: harvest (reagent: cells, other: {'day': '5'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
coat(container='12-well plate', reagent='anti-mouse CD3ε, clone 145-2C11', concentration='3 µg/ml', day='0')
incubate(container='12-well plate', temperature='37°C', duration='2 hours')
incubate(container='12-well plate', temperature='4°C', duration='overnight', alternative=True)
decant(container='12-well plate', reagent='antibody solution', aseptically=True)
wash(container='12-well plate', reagent='sterile PBS', wash_number='1/3')
wash(container='12-well plate', reagent='sterile PBS', wash_number='2/3')
wash(container='12-well plate', reagent='sterile PBS', wash_number='3/3')
discard(container='12-well plate', reagent='liquid')
